# QuietYieldGroup Guides

> Plain-English checklists, templates and calculators for Australian small businesses (allied health practices, trades, cleaning businesses, businesses paying contractors). Built from official sources and dated. General information, not advice. Publisher: QuietYieldGroup.

## Products
- [Get Paid From Day One: Allied Health Practice Setup Checklist (Australia)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-health-setup/): The registration and setup checklist for a new Australian allied health practice. 2026 edition, current as of 17 November 2026. A$29. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-health-setup/free-preview.pdf
- [Winning Council and Government Work in Queensland: Small Trade Firm Guide](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/qld-tenders-guide/): Where Queensland public jobs are listed, how council quotes work, and how to get onto panels (2026 edition) A$24. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/qld-tenders-guide/free-preview.pdf
- [Australian Cleaning Business Pricing Kit FY2026-27 | Award Rate Calculator](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/cleaning-kit/): Price domestic, end-of-lease and office cleans from the 1 July 2026 Cleaning Services Award rates, 12% super and GST: Excel calculator, quote template and checklists. A$35. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/cleaning-kit/free-preview.pdf
- [TPAR Contractor Payments Tracker – Australia 2026-27 (Excel + Guide)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/tpar-tracker/): Record contractor payments through the year in the form the ATO's Taxable payments annual report asks for, with a whole-dollar total for each contractor. A$15. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/tpar-tracker/free-preview.pdf
- [Capability Statement Template Australia: Word Kit for Trades (2026)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/capability-kit/): Editable one- and two-page Word template, a short guide and three filled-in examples for council, government and commercial work A$15. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/capability-kit/free-preview.pdf
- [Allied Health Practice Compliance Calendar 2026-27 (Australia)](https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-renewals/): A printable year planner and spreadsheet tracker for the renewals, registrations and recurring dates a small allied health practice has to keep current. A$12. Free preview: https://quietyieldgroup.github.io/guides/allied-renewals/free-preview.pdf
